name: agent-team-os
description: Build and run your own AI agent team. Scaffolds a team repo with an orchestrator and five agents, walks you through a resumable 9-phase install, and audits the result. Level 2 of The Claude Code Workshop.

plugins.name: agent-team-os
plugins.description: Hire workers, not tools. /onboard builds your team repo end to end in nine resumable phases. /new-agent adds a specialist. /add-pack installs a ready-made one. /audit tells you what is working, what is stale, and what was never set up.
